conventions.cross_track_reference: Always name the track in prose AND link it: Cost & Cash Week 5. A bare 'Week N' always means the current track, because the sidebar already lists those.
conventions.inline_links: Body prose carries links ONLY for cross-track references. Styled in style.css under .article-body a — inherits text colour, emerald underline.
conventions.copyright: Free: clause numbers, official clause headings in italics as citation, the effect of a clause in our own words, terminology, attributed findings, our own $1M invention. Forbidden: any quotation from a source, redrawing a source figure, following a source's teaching order, carrying a numeric example across. Test: write the sentence from memory without the source open. Not legal advice.
conventions.contraction_density: Track 1 ~25/1000 words, Tracks 2 and 3 ~8/1000. Track 1 is deliberately the most conversational.
conventions.article_shape: h1 (4-9 word editorial hook) -> H2 repeating h1 -> 7-9 H2s -> 3 SVG figures -> Practical insight -> Key takeaways (7 x tick) -> What's coming next. 1,400-1,600 words.
